summary: From a blank file you write tool_executor.py: a Pydantic model for the input, a schema made from it, validation, and error results for a bad format, an unknown code and an unknown tool. Then you run six calls and read each result.
goal: Validate tool input and return a clear error result, from a blank file.

items.text: Write down which of the six calls will be errors and the message for each
Write tool_executor.py and run_cases.py from the contract, without the solution
Run it and compare the six results with your prediction
Write the tests, one for a good call and one for each kind of error
Run pytest and mypy, then commit
Play the Tool Error Check game to the end and see your score
